title: Easy toddler breakfast roll-ups
summary: Simple, filling, and made with just a few ingredients! Shredded cheese Avocado slices Cook the egg over low-medium heat, then place the tortilla right on top.
caption: Easy toddler breakfast roll-ups 🌯🥑🧀 Simple, filling, and made with just a few ingredients! 🍳 1 egg 🌯 1 @sietefoods almond flour tortilla 🧀 Shredded cheese 🥑 Avocado slices Cook the egg over low-medium heat, then place the tortilla right on top. Once the egg is mostly cooked, flip it over, sprinkle on some shredded cheese, and add avocado slices. Roll it up, let it cool, then cut into toddler-friendly slices. And for the inevitable toddler mess 😅 she’s wearing her @esembly washable bib with a higher catch pouch to help catch all those little bites! Easy breakfast roll-ups for busy mornings! 🤍 #toddlerbreakfast #toddlermeals #toddlerfood #toddlerrecipes #easyrecipe
